title: The original Dixieland band and Tony Sbarbaro
summary: They work out who was in the original Dixieland band, and Levy says he knew its drummer.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Well, yeah, La Rocca and Shields. Yeah, Shields, yes. And Munez might have been. Munez, yeah, yes it was. Yeah, Yellow Munez. There was a fellow by the name of Gussie, Gussie, what was his name, was the trombone for a while. And the piano player was Ragus. Yes, that's right. Now, those fellows, when they came north, shifted around a little bit. They did, they had a choral.

They had a choral, they had a choral. I know it. You know, I know Tony Ladder very well. Tony Ladder was the drummer that followed the first drummer they had. I know him very well, and he told me quite a bit about it, and I was telling him, he laughed, and I told him how his kids used to walk down the stairs, and I think, pretty sure it was Gunn-Raw's Cave, and listened to that music, and it was so entrancing, it had so much to it, I gave.
